newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Paribas says sell URC.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Paribas says sell URC.

text.p: Paribas Asia Equity has advised investors to sell shares of Philippine food firm Universal Robina Corp due to the negative impact of the depreciation of the peso.
"In response to the de facto devaluation of the peso, we have downgraded our forecast for URC," analyst Jomar Lacson said in a research paper.
He said URC is exposed to currency movements since it imports a significant amount of its raw materials like wheat, corn and skimmed milk.
"We have downgraded our earnings forecast for 1998 by 11.6 percent as we expect the full impact of the depreciation to be felt next year once 1997 inventories are depleted."
